description: This is a PHP source file defining a helper class 'Acceptance' within the 'Helper' namespace, extending 'Module', and containing methods for acceptance testing in SuiteCRM. It includes test setup and cleanup routines related to module files.

classes.name: Acceptance
classes.description: A helper class for acceptance testing in SuiteCRM, providing methods to verify page content and cleanup routines for modules post-test.

methods.name: seePageHas
methods.description: Verifies if a specific text appears on a page using WebDriver, catches exceptions and returns a boolean.

methods.name: _beforeSuite
methods.description: Runs cleanup before the test suite begins.

methods.name: _afterSuite
methods.description: Runs cleanup after the test suite completes.

methods.name: deleteModulesHelper
methods.description: Deletes module files and directories as part of cleanup, handling exceptions.

methods.name: deleteModuleFiles
methods.description: Deletes specific files and directories related to a module to reset test environment.
